'''2000 RopeCon''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held at RopeCon, the Finnish role-playing and games convention, in summer 2000. [[Christoffer Niska]] posted that his Dark deck "went 3-0 beating Profit mains and 2 MWYHL decks" there.<ref name="dt-9169">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9169 Brake Stuff], DeckTech (Christoffer "Thedit" Niska, 6 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9169/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9169/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2000 (before 6 August)
* '''Site:''' RopeCon, Finland
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
